draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.46, the 15th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 2nd of 19 at RB. He went 24th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Steven Jackson. Testing concerns: broad jump (13th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 1st in rushing yards among the 19 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 71 career games and 68 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 running back who played: 86 scrimmage yards against a median of 396, below the norm.
